# Cohort

## Summary
One run of a Course with term, seats, instructors and release EVENTS. The operational unit: things are released to it, attended in it, closed on it. `buildCohortWeeks()` feeds the Cohort Timeline.

## Usage
Mounts Cohort Workspace in isolated when a context is present.

## Non-goals
Enrolments are their own cards (unbounded).
